title: Design System: Victor Ramos · Crédito Imobiliário

heading.purpose: One H2 per section, no eyebrow above it.

body.purpose: Short didactic sentences in Victor's voice.

shadows.name: glass
shadows.purpose: Glass chips over the hero portrait.

components.name: CTA Button
components.description: The only orange element: opens WhatsApp.
components.css: .ds-btn-cta { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:10px; min-height:52px; padding:0 26px; border:0; border-radius:999px; background:#F39200; color:#0B1F3A; font:600 16px Inter, sans-serif; box-shadow:0 6px 16px -6px rgba(0,0,0,.4); transition:transform 160ms cubic-bezier(0.23,1,0.32,1), background-color 240ms ease; cursor:pointer; } .ds-btn-cta:hover { background:#FFA524; } .ds-btn-cta:active { transform:scale(0.97); } .ds-btn-cta:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #F39200; outline-offset:3px; }

components.name: Glass Chip
components.description: Benefit chip floating over the hero portrait.
components.css: .ds-chip { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:10px; padding:12px 16px; border-radius:16px; color:#fff; font:600 14px Inter, sans-serif; background:linear-gradient(140deg, rgba(255,255,255,.18), rgba(255,255,255,.07)); border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.22); backdrop-filter:blur(14px) saturate(150%); box-shadow:0 10px 30px -10px rgba(3,12,28,.55); } .ds-tick { display:grid; place-items:center; width:28px; height:28px; border-radius:999px; background:#F39200; color:#0B1F3A; font-size:13px; }

components.name: Chat Bubbles
components.description: Signature: visitor doubts (white, right) answered by Victor (navy, left).
components.html:
Será que meu crédito é aprovado?

Comigo você tem um especialista do seu lado em cada etapa.
components.css: .ds-thread { display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:12px; padding:24px; background:#EAF3FB; border-radius:32px; } .ds-b { max-width:22rem; margin:0; padding:16px 20px; border-radius:24px; font:400 17px/1.35 Inter, sans-serif; } .ds-b-in { align-self:flex-end; background:#fff; color:#0B1F3A; border-bottom-right-radius:6px; box-shadow:0 8px 24px -8px rgba(11,31,58,.10); } .ds-b-out { align-self:flex-start; background:#0B1F3A; color:#fff; border-bottom-left-radius:6px; font:600 19px/1.3 Sora, sans-serif; }

components.name: Service Card
components.description: White card with blue icon tile; lifts 4px on hover.
components.html:
Uso do FGTS

Na entrada, para amortizar o saldo devedor ou reduzir parcelas.
components.css: .ds-card { max-width:320px; padding:28px; background:#fff; border-radius:24px; box-shadow:0 1px 2px rgba(11,31,58,.04), 0 8px 24px -8px rgba(11,31,58,.10); outline:1px solid rgba(227,232,239,.7); transition:transform 240ms cubic-bezier(0.23,1,0.32,1), box-shadow 240ms; } .ds-card:hover { transform:translateY(-4px); box-shadow:0 2px 4px rgba(11,31,58,.05), 0 20px 40px -16px rgba(11,31,58,.22); } .ds-tile { display:block; width:48px; height:48px; border-radius:16px; background:#EAF3FB; } .ds-card h3 { margin:24px 0 8px; font:700 20px Sora, sans-serif; color:#0B1F3A; letter-spacing:-.03em; } .ds-card p { margin:0; font:400 16px/1.6 Inter, sans-serif; color:#3D4F68; }

components.name: Dark Input
components.description: Lead form field on the navy closing block.
components.css: .ds-input { width:100%; min-height:52px; padding:0 16px; border:0; border-radius:16px; background:rgba(255,255,255,.08); color:#fff; font:400 16px Inter, sans-serif; box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(255,255,255,.2); } .ds-input::placeholder { color:#A9C2E0; } .ds-input:focus { outline:none; background:rgba(255,255,255,.12); box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 2px #F39200; }

narrative.overview: Night-navy fields bracket an off-white reading ground. The page reads like the WhatsApp conversation it exists to start: doubts arrive as bubbles, Victor answers, the path is shown in four steps, and orange always means 'talk to Victor'.
keyCharacteristics: Dark hero with cut-out portrait and glass chips

rules.name: The One Action Rule
rules.body: Orange is only for actions that open WhatsApp or submit the lead form.

rules.name: No Caixa imitation
rules.body: Never the Caixa logo or its look; only the text 'Correspondente bancário Caixa' and a reserved seal slot.

dos: Do keep claims verifiable and rules caveated
Do give every press an :active state
donts: Don't add eyebrow labels above headings
Don't use gradient text or colored glows
